name: @50heads/mcp

tools.name: estimate
tools.description: Price a question before asking it: credits, the price, how long it will take and any fixes it needs. Never spends. Call this first, and when a person is present show them the price and time together before you ask.

text.description: The question as a head reads it. One question, answerable in five seconds.

content_flag.description: Sensitive content in the question or its images (see 50heads.com/content-policy): "medical" (injuries, conditions), "violence", "distressing" (news, disasters, death), "alcohol_gambling" or "political". Only heads who opted in see a flagged question, and it shows a content warning first. Default "none". Sexual content, nudity and hate symbols are refused.

answered_by.description: Who answers. "heads" (default): verified people 50heads finds, priced by tier. "private": your own audience, through a link you share; people answer in the browser with no account, 5 credits an accepted answer, no tier, rush or targeting, never free text. The result says the answers were not verified by 50heads.

open_for_days.description: private only: days the link stays open. Default 7.

shown_as.description: private only: your organisation's name on the answer page ("Acme asks"). Plain text, reviewed with the question.

public_results.description: Show the result on a public page: for heads, a shareable results page; for answered_by "private", the bars people see after their own answer. Default false.

context.description: One line of background shown under the question, only when a head needs it.

language.description: Language of the question and its options, such as "en", "fr" or "pt". Heads answer in it. Omit only if it is obvious from the text.

image_url.description: An https image URL or a pre-signed upload URL (POST /v1/uploads). Never inline base64.

exposure_ms.description: Five-second test: show the image for this long (5000 is usual), then hide it and ask. Needs image_url. × 1.3.

stimulus.description: Shown above the question: one image or one line of text.

n.description: How many heads should answer. Default 50; 100 or more for a decision.

tier.description: 1 phone-verified (20 credits an answer), 2 ID-verified (42), 3 established heads (80). Default 1.

rush.description: Aim for under an hour at any size. × 1.5.

country.description: ISO country codes, such as ["GB", "IE"]. See 50heads://countries.

tags.description: Tag ids from 50heads://targeting, any tier (heads declare them). Any tag in a group matches.

age_bands.description: Age bands heads declared, or from the ID check with verified_age.

verified_age.description: Count only the age band from the Tier 2 ID check. Needs tier 2 or 3.

targeting.description: Who answers. Omit to ask everyone who reads the language. Countries are free. Age, gender and each tag group are one trait each: up to 4, 3 credits an answer per trait (PickFu charges about $0.40). OR within a trait, AND across. estimate returns pool_size and a time that allows for it.

min_grade.description: 1 Member (passed the questions), 2 Verified (passed more), 3 Trusted (checked by a person). Default 1.

audience.description: Ask an interest audience instead of targeting: a panel of heads who proved they fit (list_audiences). It replaces targeting, and the price per answer is the audience's at the grade, before length, format and images.

image_url.description: An https image URL or a pre-signed upload URL (POST /v1/uploads). Never inline base64.

neither.description: Add a "Neither" option at the end.

reason.description: A short written "why" with every answer (10 to 140 characters): "optional" (+0.3 format) or "required" (+0.6 format). Default "off". Heads answer a little slower. Reasons come back with each answer and in the summary.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: The results so far for a question: status, how many answered, the split per option, the winner, margin and confidence, breakdowns by country, tier, age band, gender and tag (groups of 5 or more), taps and hot spots for click tests, the split for reactions, any written answers and reasons (translated into the account's language), and a summary of them (themes, sentiment, a takeaway). Filter by option, tier, country, age_band, gender or keyword to read one group. Does not wait: while the question is live it returns a partial result.

question_id.description: The question_id from ask or list_questions.

currency.description: Currency for the price. Default: your account currency.

option.description: Only answers that picked this option (0-based; ranking: ranked it first).

tier.description: Only answers from heads at this tier.

country.description: Only answers from this country (ISO code). Fewer than 5 answers show none.

age_band.description: Only this age band, such as "25-34" (the ID check, else what heads declared). Fewer than 5 show none.

gender.description: Only heads who declared this gender. Fewer than 5 show none.

keyword.description: Only answers whose written words (reason or free text) contain this.

tools.name: wait_for_results
tools.description: Waits on the server until the question is answered, or min_answers are in, or the timeout passes (default 300 s, most 600), then returns the results. One call instead of polling. If it comes back still live, call it again.

question_id.description: The question_id from ask or list_questions.

min_answers.description: Return as soon as this many heads have answered.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait on the server. Default 300, most 600.

tools.name: list_questions
tools.description: Your recent questions with status and answer counts, newest first. Check here before asking again: a recent answer may already cover it. Filter by project, label, your own external reference, bookmark or set (ask_set); archived questions are left out unless you ask for them.

since.description: Only questions asked after this time (ISO 8601).

external_ref.description: Only the question with your own reference, set when asked.

archived.description: Archived questions are left out unless you ask for them (default exclude).

bookmarked.description: Only bookmarked questions (true) or the others (false).

set_id.description: Only the questions of one set (from ask_set), in order.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Stops a live question. Heads who have not answered are refunded; answers already given are kept and paid for. Safe to call twice.

question_id.description: The question_id from ask or list_questions.

tools.name: templates
tools.description: Ready-made questions at a fixed price. Pick one, fill in its options and pass its question to ask with template_id. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Credits available, credits reserved by live questions, and what is left under this connection's daily spend cap. Check before asking something large.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Puts an image into 50heads so a question can show it: base64 bytes (data), or a public https link to copy (image_url). Returns image_url to use in a question's options or stimulus. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB; metadata is stripped and heads never load your server. Costs nothing.

image_url.description: A public https image to copy into 50heads. Use this for images already online.

data.description: The image as base64 (a data: URL is fine): JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. The hosted server takes requests up to 1 MB, so send bigger files by image_url or through the stdio server.

content_type.description: The type of data. Read from the bytes when left out.

tools.name: get_answers
tools.description: Individual answers to a question, newest first, a page at a time: the option picked, any written answer or reason, tier and an attestation_ref. Filter by option, tier, country, age band or a keyword (q); pass next_cursor for the next page. Answers never identify a head.

question_id.description: The question_id from ask or list_questions.

option.description: Only answers that picked this option (0 is the first).

tier.description: Only answers from this tier.

country.description: ISO country code. Shows nothing unless 5 or more answers match.

age_band.description: Such as "25-34". Shows nothing unless 5 or more answers match.

gender.description: Declared gender. Shows nothing unless 5 or more answers match.

q.description: A word or phrase in written answers and reasons.

tools.name: add_heads
tools.description: Asks more heads the same question, with the same targeting, and merges their answers into the same result. Spends credits at the question's per-answer price, within this connection's daily cap. Needs a fresh UUID as idempotency_key; retrying with it never charges twice.

question_id.description: The question_id from ask or list_questions.

n.description: How many more heads to ask. At least 10.

idempotency_key.description: A fresh UUID. Retrying with the same key never adds or charges twice.

tools.name: flag_answer
tools.description: Reports one answer that looks off-topic, low effort, abusive or automated, by its attestation_ref from get_answers or get_results. 50heads reviews it; an upheld flag removes the answer and refunds it. Flagging the same answer again changes nothing.

question_id.description: The question_id from ask or list_questions.

reason.description: off_topic, low_effort, abusive, or automated (looks like a bot or copy-paste).

note.description: What is wrong with it, in a sentence.

tools.name: export
tools.description: A question's results as a file: csv (every answer, with the same filters as get_answers), pdf (a one-page report) or png (the result card). Returns the file in the reply when it is small enough, and its API url.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Searches the 50heads help centre (asking, results, credits and billing, verification, the API and MCP) and returns the best articles with links. Use it to answer a person's question about how 50heads works. No sign-in needed.

query.description: What you want to know, in a few words.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Sends feedback or a problem to 50heads support as a ticket; a person replies by email. Use it when something about 50heads or this server did not work, or to suggest something. Signed in, the reply goes to the account's email; otherwise add email.

message.description: The feedback or problem, in plain words. Leave out personal data about other people.

email.description: Only when not signed in, so support can reply.

instructions: 50heads asks verified people a five-second question and returns how they split. Use it for human preferences and first impressions, never for facts. Call estimate first and show the price and time together when a person is present; then ask with a fresh UUID as idempotency_key, and wait on the task (or wait_for_results). Read 50heads://guide for how to word a good question.
